earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 fix-ex99d1.htm EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 ​ ​ CONTACT: Julie Shaeff, Chief Accounting Officer 9753 Katy Freeway, Suite 700 ​ ir@comfortsystemsusa.com ; 713-830-9687 Houston, Texas 77024 ​ ​ 713-830-9600 ​ FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE ​ COMFORT SYSTEMS USA REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS ​ Houston, TX — October 22, 2026 — Comfort Systems USA, Inc. (NYSE: FIX) (the “Company”) today reported results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. ​ For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, net income was $489.0 million, or $13.91 per diluted share, as compared to $291.6 million, or $8.25 per diluted share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. Revenue for the third quarter of 2026 was $3.77 billion compared to $2.45 billion in 2025. The Company reported operating cash flow of $1.01 billion in the current quarter compared to $553.3 million in 2025. ​ Brian Lane, Comfort Systems USA’s Chief Executive Officer, said, “Strong ongoing demand and consistent excellence by our teams resulted in extraordinary results across every metric this quarter. As compared to the same quarter last year, Comfort Systems USA is reporting a 50% increase in revenue and a 70% jump in per share earnings. We also achieved remarkable cash flow exceeding $1 billion in a single quarter. Our teams continue their superb execution, providing great outcomes for our customers and communities.” ​ Backlog as of September 30, 2026 was $17.81 billion as compared to $14.06 billion as of June 30, 2026 and $9.38 billion as of September 30, 2025. On a same-store basis, backlog increased from $9.38 billion as of September 30, 2025 to $17.39 billion as of September 30, 2026. ​ Mr. Lane concluded, “Relentless demand, together with our competence and reputation, produced sequential backlog growth of $3.8 billion, and a year over year backlog increase exceeding $8.0 billion. We continue to experience robust demand, and thanks to the dedication and excellence of our workforce, we believe that through year end and for 2027 we are well-positioned to grow organically, and to maintain high levels of profitability and solid ongoing cash flow.” ​ The Company reported net income of $1.30 billion, or $36.94 per diluted share, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $691.8 million, or $19.52 per diluted share, in 2025. The Company also reported revenue of $9.90 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $6.46 billion in 2025. Operating cash flow for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was $2.54 billion, as compared to $717.8 million in 2025. ​ The Company will host a webcast and conference call to discuss its financial results and position on Friday, October 23, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Central Time. To register for the call, please visit https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIadd092e43bfe46868f23208875b8c879 . Upon registering, participants will receive dial-in information and a unique PIN to join the call. The call and the slide presentation to accompany the remarks can be accessed on the Company’s website at https://comfortsystemsusa.com under the “Investors” tab. A replay of the entire call will be available on the Company’s website on the next business day following the call. ​ Comfort Systems USA ® is a leading provider of commercial, industrial and institutional heating, ventilation, air conditioning and electrical contracting services, with 211 locations in 155 cities across the nation. For more information, visit the Company’s website at https://comfortsystemsusa.com . ​ Certain statements and information in this press release may constitute forward-looking statements regarding our future business expectations, which are subject to applicable securities laws and regulations. reference.summary: Comfort Systems USA, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides mechanical and electrical installation, renovation, maintenance, repair, and replacement services for the mechanical and electrical services industry in the United States. The company operates through two segments: Mechanical and Electrical. It offers heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems, as well as plumbing, electrical, piping and controls, off-site construction, monitoring, and fire protection. The company is also involved in the design, engineering, integration, installation, and start-up of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) and related systems in new buildings; and renovation, expansion, maintenance, monitoring, repair, and replacement of systems in existing buildings.
